name: #RBCBrooklynHalf
description:
Gave up pace at 10M. 2 spectacular runner’s highs. First dip into the cold and wonderful ocean at Coney Island. 🌊

There was a wave 1 runner unconscious being given CPR at mile 8-9. I just learned that he unfortunately died.
